mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a record of God's revelations to and His relationship with human beings."
The Bible is a record of God's revelations to and His relationship with human beings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in a manner that accords with its nature."
An instrument is used in a manner that accords with its nature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the oldest among the Hebrew Scriptures."
The Syriac Version The Syriac Version is the oldest among the Hebrew Scriptures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called inspired because they are the divinely determined products of inspired men."
The Biblical books are called inspired because they are the divinely determined products of inspired men.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instance in which two or more manuscripts differ regarding the form of a text."
A variant reading is an instance in which two or more manuscripts differ regarding the form of a text.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the incapability of erring in judgement or failing to bring true and correct judgments to adequate expression and is more properly applied to author of the Sacred Book."
Infallibility refers to the incapability of erring in judgement or failing to bring true and correct judgments to adequate expression and is more properly applied to author of the Sacred Book.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fact that the Qumran library contained much in the original languages of what are called apocrypha and pseudepigrapha as well as literary works heretofore unknown."
Equally interesting is the fact that the Qumran library contained much in the original languages of what are called apocrypha and pseudepigrapha as well as literary works heretofore unknown.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called inspired because they were breathed into by the Holy Spirit, so that the product of their activities transcends human powers and becomes divinely authoritative."
The Biblical writers are called inspired because they were breathed into by the Holy Spirit, so that the product of their activities transcends human powers and becomes divinely authoritative.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only papyrus to contain biblical books without lacunae. 3.1.1.6."
P72 is the only papyrus to contain biblical books without lacunae. 3.1.1.6.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those giving the equivalence of ancient coinage with the contemporary day's or year's wages of a labourer (Matt 18: 24, 28; 20:2)."
Among the new notes are those giving the equivalence of ancient coinage with the contemporary day's or year's wages of a labourer (Matt 18: 24, 28; 20:2).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Minuscule, and the oldest of these, 461 is dated to the 9th century."
The greater majority of NT manuscripts are the Minuscule, and the oldest of these, 461 is dated to the 9th century.
